query: Write a market research report on the US pet insurance market for a carrier deciding whether to launch a direct-to-consumer product.
expected_behavior: Creates sources/research_log.md with a URL, publisher, and data year for every market-size, CAGR, and share figure
Cites at least two sources for market size and states the range when they differ
Renders charts only from data/charts.json via make_charts.py; no chart contains numbers absent from the log
check_report.py prints PASS with at least 50 pages
Recommendations address the launch decision named in the request

query: I need a 25-page market sizing and competitive landscape study on agricultural drone spraying services in Brazil.
expected_behavior: Uses 25 as the page minimum (check_report.py --min-pages 25) instead of 50
States data gaps for thin chapters rather than padding them
Deletes figure environments for charts that were not rendered
Sets \baseyear to the latest year with actual data

query: Give me a quick read on whether the EV charging market is still growing.
expected_behavior: Does not start the 50-page report workflow; answers briefly or asks whether a full report is wanted
